<div class="learn-box">
**What you will learn**

Read table and column metadata, then interpret safe counts.
</div>

This chapter uses the public synthetic GiBleed practice connection from [Getting started](book-00-start.html).
**You need:** the packages and the matching practice connection described in
[Before you start](book-00-start.html#before-you-start).
Run the sections in order in one R session. All printed results below were computed
with dsOMOP and dsOMOPClient 2.10.5. They are teaching data, not clinical findings.

## Start this chapter

Start a fresh R session in the `book-work` directory created in
[Getting started](book-00-start.html#get-the-book-helpers). Run this setup first:


``` r
library(dsOMOPClient)
source("tools/book/display.R")
source("tools/book/connection.R")
source("tools/book/practice.R")
practice <- if (book_driver == "DSLite") book_practice("gibleed") else book_connect("gibleed")
conns <- practice$conns
names(conns)
```

```
#> [1] "site"
```

The `site` connection is ready. The shared `connection.R` selects DSLite or Opal and resolves the resource names.

## Read the question and answer fields


``` r
knitr::kable(ds.omop.columns("observation", conns = conns)$site)
```



|column_name                   |cdm_datatype |db_datatype |concept_role      |semantic_class |fk_domain    |is_date |is_extension |is_untyped_identifier |is_sensitive |is_blocked |is_quasi_identifier |
|:-----------------------------|:------------|:-----------|:-----------------|:--------------|:------------|:-------|:------------|:---------------------|:------------|:----------|:-------------------|
|observation_id                |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|person_id                     |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|observation_concept_id        |integer      |real        |domain_concept    |concept        |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|observation_date              |date         |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|observation_datetime          |datetime     |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|observation_type_concept_id   |integer      |real        |type_concept      |concept        |Type Concept |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|value_as_number               |float        |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|value_as_string               |varchar(60)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|value_as_concept_id           |Integer      |real        |attribute_concept |concept        |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|qualifier_concept_id          |integer      |real        |attribute_concept |concept        |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|unit_concept_id               |integer      |real        |attribute_concept |concept        |Unit         |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|provider_id                   |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|visit_occurrence_id           |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|visit_detail_id               |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|observation_source_value      |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|observation_source_concept_id |integer      |real        |source_concept    |concept        |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|unit_source_value             |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|qualifier_source_value        |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |

`observation_concept_id` identifies the question. `value_as_concept_id` identifies
a coded answer. Filtering on the question and reading the answer are two separate
choices. `value_as_number` is for numeric values; it is not our education answer.

## Count safely


``` r
ds.omop.table.stats("observation", conns = conns)$per_site$site
```

```
#> $rows
#> [1] 1475
#> 
#> $persons
#> [1] 670
```

An observation row is an answer, not necessarily a distinct person. Repeated
answers mean that counting rows and counting people can give different results.
Respect the returned disclosure representation; do not reinterpret a band as an
exact number or a refused result as an empty table.

## Identify the date field


``` r
knitr::kable(ds.omop.columns("visit_occurrence", conns = conns)$site)
```



|column_name                   |cdm_datatype |db_datatype |concept_role      |semantic_class |fk_domain    |is_date |is_extension |is_untyped_identifier |is_sensitive |is_blocked |is_quasi_identifier |

|visit_occurrence_id           |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|person_id                     |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|visit_concept_id              |integer      |real        |domain_concept    |concept        |Visit        |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|visit_start_date              |date         |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|visit_start_datetime          |datetime     |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|visit_end_date                |date         |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|visit_end_datetime            |datetime     |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |TRUE    |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |TRUE                |
|visit_type_concept_id         |Integer      |real        |type_concept      |concept        |Type Concept |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|provider_id                   |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|care_site_id                  |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|visit_source_value            |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|visit_source_concept_id       |integer      |real        |source_concept    |concept        |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|admitting_source_concept_id   |integer      |real        |source_concept    |concept        |Visit        |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|admitting_source_value        |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|discharge_to_concept_id       |integer      |real        |attribute_concept |concept        |Visit        |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |
|discharge_to_source_value     |varchar(50)  |text        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |TRUE         |TRUE       |FALSE               |
|preceding_visit_occurrence_id |integer      |real        |non_concept       |ordinary       |             |FALSE   |FALSE        |FALSE                 |FALSE        |FALSE      |FALSE               |

`visit_start_date` records when a visit started. `visit_concept_id` describes its
setting, such as inpatient or outpatient. `visit_type_concept_id` describes the
provenance of the record; it is not the field for that setting filter.

## Compare events with people

A visit table can contain repeated rows per person. Request its protected summary
before assuming a count of visits is a count of participants.


``` r
ds.omop.table.stats("visit_occurrence", conns = conns)$per_site$site
```

```
#> $rows
#> [1] 1035
#> 
#> $persons
#> [1] 890
```

Compare the returned row and distinct-person representations with the earlier
observation summary. They describe different clinical events and may use bands.
Neither a large row count nor the presence of a numeric column guarantees the
support needed for a specific lab, category or model.

## Recap

Schema exploration tells you which fields exist. Safe counts describe support without returning records.

**Next:** [4. Finding the concept IDs you need](book-04-vocabulary.html).
